author: He Shi, School of Computing, National University of Singapore
required_final_artifacts: Runnable experiment logs from Ubuntu host
unverified_claims: OpenEvolve-style subproblem optimization improves downstream research outcomes.
The full co-pilot v3 system outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2 on selected tasks.
Current package satisfies artifact-delivery requirements, but top-conference empirical support remains incomplete; see top_conference_readiness_audit.md.
next_required_evidence: Run at least 5 matched-budget pairs per task across at least 3 tasks, with means, variance, and paired tests before making superiority claims.
Run matched mini-manuscript scoring on complete end-to-end co-pilot and autonomous manuscripts, not only package mini-manuscripts.
Demonstrate one continuous end-to-end trajectory from new hypothesis generation to experiments, claim audit, and final manuscript, plus a matched autonomous manuscript baseline.
Populate attention_cost and taste_insight in all future prospective human gates, then compare downstream outcomes and human effort.
Obtain at least one scored official non-FML benchmark with a complete matched comparison when data access permits.
Rewrite the main manuscript into a focused conference-paper structure after stronger evidence is available; keep current version as pilot/reproducibility package.

model_routing_policy.hypothesis_debate: Monica-routed GPT/Gemini/Anthropic frontier model when budget allows
model_routing_policy.claim_audit: Monica-routed high-reliability model plus human review
model_routing_policy.api_secret_policy: Read from environment variables; never print keys.

openevolve_policy.reason: Official AlphaEvolve core algorithm and infrastructure are not open sourced.
openevolve_policy.first_task: examples/function_minimization smoke run or equivalent deterministic local task
openevolve_policy.required_comparison: direct LLM edit baseline under the same evaluator and iteration budget

clean_clone_reproducibility_audit.note: Verifies the latest pushed package before the metadata-update commit that records this audit.

prospective_matched_package_summary.interpretation: four passing prospective packages; one micro-task co-pilot win and three FML negative_or_invalid outcomes; superiority_not_supported

online_trajectory_manuscript_probe.interpretation: This narrows the fresh online manuscript-production gap and adds a same-continuous-trajectory autonomous manuscript comparator; it remains a tiny-budget smoke without independent paper-quality review.

latest_online_full_gate_smoke.claim_scope: fresh same-continuous-trajectory paired online smoke plus manuscript production; not superiority evidence

online_matched_budget_manuscript_compara.interpretation: This adds an autonomous manuscript comparator to the online trajectory manuscript probe. It is a same-continuous-trajectory baseline when generated from the same online run; it still needs more tasks, seeds, and independent paper-quality review before supporting final paper-quality claims.

same_continuous_paper_quality_model_revi.limitation: Monica-routed model review over one tiny-budget same-continuous smoke; not independent human expert review.

structured_feedback_probe.scope_note: Same-base-manuscript, same-model probe comparing informal feedback against IGRE-structured feedback. This is measurement-readiness evidence only, not independent human expert review.

hypothesis_frontend_baseline_probe.scope_note: Same-model front-end portfolio comparison between archived IGRE hypothesis generation and an autonomous AI Scientist-v2-style baseline. This is direction-finding evidence only, not downstream benchmark or paper-quality evidence.

expert_review_taste_prior_probe.claim_boundary: Offline expert-review taste proxy only; not proof of live human co-pilot improvement.

participation_mode_selection_probe.claim_boundary: Offline OpenReview-derived model-routed workflow-selection probe only.

openreview_guided_regeneration_probe.claim_boundary: Real OpenReview text used as human taste/insight, but regenerated mini-paper artifacts only.

review_insight_taxonomy_probe.claim_boundary: OpenReview-derived actionable-review taxonomy only; not causal proof.

review_utility_map_probe.claim_boundary: Deterministic OpenReview utility map; not causal proof of final paper improvement.

openreview_regeneration_cross_model_revi.claim_boundary: Cross-model review reduces same-model scoring bias for regenerated mini-paper artifacts, but it is still model-routed artifact review, not independent human peer review or experiment rerun.

latest_paper_quality_review.claim_boundary: Focused manuscript now includes a primary-claim boundary, unified evidence table, and OpenReview information-quantity confound; still not top-conference empirical support.

focused_paper_quality_review.claim_boundary: Focused manuscript now incorporates the equal-context OpenReview ablation; independent human expert review remains missing.

openreview_equal_context_ablation.claim_boundary: This ablation controls for extra context by comparing real paper-specific review guidance against matched-length unrelated review context. It still uses model-routed scoring rather than independent human expert review, and does not rerun the original experiments.

summarizer_smoke.claim_boundary: Smoke test only; it uses the empty template and is not human evidence.

human_expert_blind_review_packet.claim_boundary: Prepared preregistered blind review materials and collection tooling only; no independent human expert results are claimed.

csv_validation.claim_boundary: Validation tooling only; no human ratings are collected.

preregistration.claim_boundary: Preregistration only; no independent human ratings have been collected.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.temporal_asymmetry_hypothesis: Short-term artifact quality can decrease while long-term frontier alignment increases.

smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic smoke test for the retrospective frontier-alignment protocol. Frontier descriptors are manually specified placeholders, not a citation-backed SOTA reconstruction. Use it as pipeline evidence, not as proof that historical reviewers predicted later research.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.claim_boundary: The smoke proves pipeline executability and records a negative heuristic result; it does not prove literature-backed future-frontier alignment.

citation_probe.citation_source: Semantic Scholar Graph API with OpenAlex fallback
citation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a lightweight citation-backed pilot using retrieved Semantic Scholar metadata and simple term-overlap scoring. It is stronger than manual descriptors but still not a full citation graph reconstruction, blinded expert review, or proof of long-term SOTA alignment. Thin or topically broad citation graphs can produce misleading frontier terms and require relevance filtering.
